title: crm.account.sale-account-checked, payload v1
description: The outcome of the account check (ADR-018 §5). Produced by account-service in the SAME transaction as the Inbox claim for the command that caused it. Destination: crm.account.evt.sale-account-checked.v1. ONE event carries both outcomes through 'result': both are facts about the same step and the orchestrator's next move is decided by the same state guard either way, so a separate failure destination would double the binding table without adding information.

orderNumber.description: The sagaId this outcome belongs to.

failureCode.description: Operator-facing detail (e.g. account-passive). Never returned to a client.

failureMessageKey.description: A CATALOG key and nothing else: MSG-ACCT-NOT-ACTIVE, MSG-ACCT-NOT-FOUND. The consumer replaces anything not shaped like this with the generic MSG-SALE-FAILED, so an exception message can never reach the status endpoint (ADR-018 §8).

customerNumber.description: SUCCEEDED only: the AUTHORITATIVE owner of the account. The sale learns who the customer is from the account, never from the browser — it is what product-service validates the service address against (ADR-015 §5.9).

productIds.description: Unused by this step. Present because account-service publishes one outcome shape for all three of its saga replies; a consumer that never reads it for this type is structurally unaffected.
